name: Dadi-Nani ke Nuskhe
summary: North Indian grandmother cures: adrak-tulsi, haldi doodh, laung, ajwain and hing.

remedies.name: Ginger Lemon Honey Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Ginger has gingerol that calms swelling, lemon brings vitamin C, and honey coats a scratchy throat.
steps: Grown-up boils a few slices of ginger in water.
Let it cool till warm, then add lemon and a spoon of honey.
Sip slowly.

remedies.name: Tulsi Adrak Kadha
remedies.howItHelps: Tulsi (holy basil) leaves have oils that help open a stuffy nose and fight germs.
steps: Boil 5 tulsi leaves, a slice of ginger and a pinch of black pepper in water.
Strain, add a little gur or honey.
Sip while warm.

remedies.name: Haldi Doodh
remedies.howItHelps: Turmeric's curcumin calms sore, swollen spots. Warm milk helps you sleep and heal.
steps: Warm a cup of milk with a pinch of turmeric and black pepper.
Drink it before bed.

remedies.name: Clove for a Toothache
remedies.howItHelps: Clove has eugenol, a natural numbing oil that quiets an achy tooth for a while.
steps: Grown-up places one whole clove gently near the sore tooth.
Hold it there; don't chew hard.
Still see a dentist!
remedies.caution: Only a grown-up should use clove oil, and never swallow it.

remedies.name: Ajwain with Kala Namak
remedies.howItHelps: Ajwain's thymol helps break up gas bubbles in a grumbly tummy.
steps: Grown-up mixes a pinch of roasted ajwain and black salt.
Chew it and sip warm water.

remedies.name: Hing Paste on the Tummy
remedies.howItHelps: A Marwari and Baniya favourite: hing (asafoetida) warms the tummy and eases gas.
steps: Grown-up mixes a pinch of hing with a few drops of warm water.
Rub it gently around the belly button.

remedies.name: Saunf Mishri
remedies.howItHelps: Fennel seeds relax the tummy muscles and freshen your breath.
steps: Chew half a spoon of saunf with a crystal of mishri after meals.

remedies.name: Chew an Elaichi
remedies.howItHelps: Cardamom's fragrance settles a queasy, wobbly tummy on long rides.
steps: Chew one green cardamom pod slowly while you travel.

remedies.name: Soaked Kishmish & Anjeer
remedies.howItHelps: Soaked raisins and figs are full of soft fiber that gets a stuck tummy moving.
steps: Soak 8 raisins and 1 fig in water overnight.
Eat them in the morning and drink the water.

remedies.name: Aam Panna
remedies.howItHelps: Raw mango drink with jeera and salt puts back the salts you sweat out on hot days.
steps: Grown-up boils raw mango and blends the pulp.
Mix with water, roasted jeera, black salt and a little gur.
Drink cool, not icy.

remedies.name: Honey & Black Pepper
remedies.howItHelps: Honey soothes a tickly throat, and pepper helps loosen the cough.
steps: Mix a spoon of honey with a tiny pinch of black pepper.
Lick it slowly.
remedies.caution: Honey is fine for big kids, never for babies under one year.

remedies.name: Haldi Lep
remedies.howItHelps: A paste of turmeric calms the swelling around an itchy bite.
steps: Grown-up mixes turmeric with a few drops of water.
Dab a little on the bite. Try not to scratch!
